data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure and step order (weather 10-day forecast, BBC "{city} strike" search, compose email with the same subject and body). It is weaker on three points: it names the recipient parameter inconsistently ({recipient}, {recipient_email}, {name}) instead of a traveler that fills both the address (@example.com) and the greeting; it ends with a vague "Send or discard" when the true workflow says never send and click Discard; and it leaves out the tab switching and the click-by-click detail, so an automation built from it would need guesswork.
